title: Finite tensor expansion with dual coordinate functionals
statement: Let k be a field and C an additive commutative group equipped with a k-module structure. For every z in C ⊗ₖ C, there exist a natural number n, families v,w : Fin n → C, and k-linear maps ell_i : C → k such that z = Σ_i v_i ⊗ w_i and ell_i(w_j) equals 1 when i = j and 0 otherwise.
lean_statement: ∀ {k : Type*} [Field k] {C : Type*} [AddCommGroup C] [Module k C] (z : TensorProduct k C C), ∃ (n : ℕ) (v w : Fin n → C) (ell : Fin n → C →ₗ[k] k), z = ∑ i : Fin n, TensorProduct.tmul k (v i) (w i) ∧ ∀ i j : Fin n, ell i (w j) = if i = j then (1 : k) else 0
